files.summary: reconcile registered authoring tools and local versus deployed qualification
edits:
Only server-to-server POST requests without an Origin are accepted. The SDK owns initialization and version negotiation. The local 2025-11-25 compatibility exercise returned working discovery/calls; some SDK compatibility responses used short SSE frames, which the client must support. The implementation does not handwrite streaming parsers or require persistent protocol sessions. Those original protocol observations did not establish native-harness compatibility. Later [local native Macrofold journeys](verification/world-agent-context.md#final-local-qualification) and [structured-question journeys](verification/invention-questions.md#final-acceptance--september-29) qualify their recorded configurations; modern-profile and target-deployment interoperability remain separate WW07 gates.
Reuse the same application descriptors, source readers and typed projections as local owner inspection. Add implemented capabilities under their actual application owners; do not register the entire target catalogue as stub tools. Current account-bound reads enforce their initiating scope, and unbound service reads exclude human-private subjects; broader recipient grants and sustained revocation qualification remain WW07/WW11 work. Preserve the private-subject checks after waits as well as reader-grant validity; WW11 records the current inspected-actor rebinding race. A broad service credential must never substitute for the recipient's authority. Read-only hints are not enforcement; actual handlers and dispatch grants determine behavior.
`OPEN_LEGEND_MCP_WRITES=true` registers the current `WORLD_AUTHORING_TOOLS` catalogue alongside the read catalogue. The original nine operations have expanded with native save-for-review, selected-kind submissions, guide reading and capability selection; this is not a nine-tool limit. Individual active agent profiles receive only their selected subset under the [runtime profile contract](world-agent-runtime.md#scoped-context-and-native-save-for-review), not every registered tool. Writes require owner/god mode, an unexpired world/connector scope and a separate current `contextHandle` issued by the authenticated application session service. No MCP tool creates a funded session, approves a plan or increases an allowance. Human approval remains in the local application UI; the model may request review and apply an already approved exact plan.
[Write continuation verification](verification/workshop-continuation.md) records the original HTTP/MCP/native and small PostgreSQL execution; later [context](verification/world-agent-context.md#final-local-qualification) and [question](verification/invention-questions.md#final-acceptance--september-29) evidence records actual local Macrofold forwarding and supported journeys. [INV-21 focused delivery](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md) retains deployable-build/target-runtime interoperability, broader failure and multi-user qualification, body changes, strict image-inclusive external budgeting and sustained scale. The endpoint is write-capable now; those larger acceptance gates remain open.
Authoring handles carry the initiating account’s current inspection/create grant and character binding. Current reader-grant and timeline checks fence subsequent tool calls and outgoing results. They do not yet close WW11's inspected-subject ownership change during awaited private-memory reads; that subject must remain authorized at disclosure, not merely when reading begins. An optional handle on a read tool selects that account’s scope; an invalid supplied handle never falls back to broader service access. Unbound service-bearer reads exclude human-private bodies, their contained items, and their memory. Exact current-format PostgreSQL records own retained evidence and operational authoring state. See [the runtime](world-agent-runtime.md#durable-write-sessions) and [integration evidence](verification/invention-main-integration.md).
